description: Mark an issued client invoice as paid after explicit confirmation. Requires a strict calendar-valid paidDate in YYYY-MM-DD format. This updates the accounts-receivable invoice record only; it never creates or moves an Income row. Record the actual payment separately or link an existing Income row.

paidDate.description: Calendar-valid payment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

paidVia.description: Optional payment method or source, such as bank transfer or check.

name: mark_client_invoice_paid
